openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The NBG6617 is an entry-level two-stream 802.11ac device and can be easily flashed with OpenWrt from stock firmware.
openwrt_wiki.versionen: So far, there is only one hardware revision of the ZyXEL NBG6617. v1: Support was introduced with commit 82618062cf.
openwrt_wiki.installation_oem: Factory image via ZyXEL web interface (Expert Mode, Maintenance, Firmware Upgrade); no need to rename the binary.

installation_tftp.Ablauf: Boot the device while holding the WPS button on the top for 30 seconds; once USB and WPS LEDs start flashing, reboot.

gehaeuse_oeffnen: Remove the 4 rubber feet at the back
Pry apart the upper side of the case, start at the upper side of the device eg. between the antenna and the usb port

openwrt_git_support.titel: ipq40xx: add support for the ZyXEL NBG6617
openwrt_git_support.ETH: Qualcomm Atheros QCA8075 Gigabit Switch (4 x LAN, 1 x WAN)
openwrt_git_support.USB: 1 x 3.0 (via Synopsys DesignWare DWC3 controller in the SoC)
openwrt_git_support.INPUT: RESET Button, WIFI/Rfkill Togglebutton, WPS Button
openwrt_git_support.LEDS: Power, WAN, LAN 1-4, WLAN 2.4GHz, WLAN 5GHz, USB, WPS
openwrt_git_support.Serial: WARNING: The serial port needs a TTL/RS-232 3.3v level converter! The Serial setting is 115200-8-N-1. The 1x4 .1" header comes pre-soldered. Pinout: 1. 3v3 (Label printed on the PCB), 2. RX, 3. GND, 4. TX
openwrt_git_support.first install / debricking: tftp-server @ 192.168.1.99/24, any LAN port, factory.bin renamed to ras.bin, power-cycle holding WPS (30 s), wait; when power LED flashes slowly and USB + WPS LEDs flash fast, reboot
openwrt_git_support.Installation via Web-UI: 192.168.1.1 (Default Passwort: 1234), Expert Mode, Maintenance, Firmware-Upgrade, upload factory image
openwrt_git_support.To open: remove the four rubber feet glued on the backside, remove the four philips screws and pry open the top cover from the backside/lan-port side
openwrt_git_support.bootloader: ZyXEL zloader v2.02 on top of u-boot (Abschnitt zum Entsperren der Bootloader-Shell bewusst nicht übernommen)

openwrt_image_mk.Kommentar: The Zyxel firmware allows flashing thru the web-gui only when the rootfs is at least as large as the one of the initial firmware image (not the current one on the device). This only applies to the Web-UI, the bootloader ignores this minimum-size.

openwrt_git_373f446.text: separate kernel partition which is 4MiB large

openwrt_git_88f39b7.titel: ipq40xx: increase SPI frequency for Zyxel NBG6617
openwrt_git_88f39b7.text: The mx25l25635f supports clock speed up to 50Mhz; chip is very very likely always the 'f' revision for all NBG6617

openwrt_git_cb18b62.titel: ipq40xx: reenable Zyxel NBG6617 by default
openwrt_git_cb18b62.text: kernel with every module enabled produced a 3058 KiB kernel (the kernel partition is 4MiB). It booted just fine
